appraisal_events.evidence: elle... exécutant certains mouvements des ailes du nez... la nullité de l'impression que lui produisaient la vue de l'historien et la mienne
appraisal_events.explanation: The duchesse's bow is performed without any acknowledgment of the narrator's presence, and she registers his sight as producing no impression on her at all, staging him as socially negligible to her.

appraisal_events.evidence: avec une politesse exagérée et le ramener avec justesse... l'inertie absolue de son attention désoeuvrée
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's elaborately satirical description of her mechanical, affected bow and idle inattention mocks the duchesse's performed hauteur, subtly diminishing her through irony even as she socially dominates the scene.

status_effects.explanation: He is pointedly unacknowledged and treated as producing no impression, positioning him as excluded from the duchesse's regard.
The narrator's ironic rendering of her exaggerated, mechanical politeness and idle disdain casts her affectation in a mildly unflattering light.

ambiguities: Whether the duchesse's snub is meant to diminish her (as haughty and affected) or simply to characterize aristocratic manner neutrally is not fully resolved by the passage; the ironic tone suggests mild authorial distance but stops short of overt condemnation.
